step.title: Choose your AI engine
step.body: Boba does its AI work through an agent CLI installed on this computer. Pick one and give it a model, then test the connection. You can change both later in Settings.
step.loadError: Boba could not look for agent CLIs on this computer.
step.invalid: Test the engine and confirm where your data goes before continuing.
step.noEngine: No agent CLI was found on this computer. Install one below, then reopen this step.
model.label: Model
model.help: Type the model name, or leave it empty to use the CLI's default.
test.successDefault: Answered in {ms} ms with the CLI's default model.
test.hint.auth_expired: Run the CLI in a terminal to log in, then test again.
test.hint.quota_exceeded: The provider's quota is used up. Wait for it to reset, then test again.
test.hint.not_found: Check the model name, or clear it to use the CLI's default.
test.hint.timeout: The CLI did not answer in time. Try again, or test another CLI.
test.hint.limit_exceeded: The test hit a limit before finishing. Try again.
test.hint.cancelled: The test was cancelled. Try again.
test.hint.unsupported: This CLI cannot run the tasks Boba needs. Pick another CLI.
test.hint.invalid_output: The CLI answered in a shape Boba cannot use. Try another CLI.
test.hint.crashed: The CLI stopped unexpectedly. Check that it runs in a terminal.
limited.body: Boba starts in Limited mode: searching, scoring and the Tracker still work. Tailoring, Profile reading and email reading wait until an AI engine is connected in Settings.
limited.chosen: Limited mode chosen. You can connect an AI engine later in Settings.
disclosure.title: Where your data goes
disclosure.body: Boba sends Profile and Offer text to the provider behind {cli} — for example {provider} — unless that CLI is configured with a local model. Only the content a task needs is sent.
disclosure.ack: I understand where my data goes
tasks.unavailable: These tasks stay unavailable on {cli}, because it has no verified tool lockdown: {tasks}.
tasks.name.tailor_application: Tailoring a CV or cover letter
